audit.whatIsWrong: Chart and whys disagreed in five of seven rows — why[0] says 'both are weak at level 1, neither side commits' under a Graves row, why[2] says 'concede the window' under a Cho'Gath row, why[4] is the Feast turn under a Graves row, and why[6] calls it 'a true coinflip' under a Cho'Gath row.
audit.why: Level 1 is even, 2-3 are Graves on shotgun poke plus Quickdraw resets, 4-5 level out once Vorpal Spikes clear arrives, 6 and first item are Cho'Gath on Feast, and two items is a coinflip against a fed Collateral Damage. That is also the only reading consistent with 50.67% over 1196 games.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Skill / Graves / Graves / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phase whys were generic template text with no cooldowns; the level-6 line said only 'Graves's ultimate changes the math too'.
audit.why: Feast is 80/70/60s, true damage, permanent max HP — it ignores the armour and MR that Quickdraw's True Grit stacks give him, which is the whole reason 6 flips. Collateral Damage is 100/80/60s and is what makes the two-item stage dangerous again. Quickdraw is 16/15/14/13/12s but his basic attacks lower it, so it is not a clean clock.
audit.corrected: Phase whys now name End of the Line, Quickdraw 16s, Collateral Damage 100s and Feast 80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry repeatedly called Graves's poke 'Buckshot' and gave it 'three pellets'. There is no Buckshot in his kit: Q is End of the Line and the shotgun cone is his passive New Destiny, which Riot's text says fires four bullets. The entry also claims Smoke Screen 'blinds your autos'; Riot's description gives it sight reduction, a slow and damage, with no blind.
audit.why: Naming matters here because the two abilities behave differently: New Destiny is an auto-attack cone limited by ammo and reload, while End of the Line (Q, 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6s, 925 range) detonates after 1 second or on terrain — which is exactly how he cuts off a Cho'Gath retreat, and Cho'Gath has no dash to answer it. Feral Scream (11s at rank 1) silences Quickdraw (16s at rank 1) and Smoke Screen (26s at rank 1) out of his hands at once.
audit.corrected: End of the Line detonates on terrain — it cuts your retreat and you have no dash. Silence locks Quickdraw for 16s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in the entry mentioned that End of the Line detonates early on terrain, which is the mechanic that makes Graves lethal to a dashless champion near a wall.
audit.why: The missing-interactions file flags exactly this: he cuts your retreat and you must hold Flash for the wall, not the damage.
audit.corrected: Added the terrain detonation to the Key Ability Interactions line.

edits.before: Farm with E spikes and respect everything — you scale, he rents. Identify how Graves contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Both weak at 1: he has End of the Line range but no Quickdraw yet, so neither side commits — secure CS and dodge the shotgun cone.

edits.before: W silence starts flipping his combo windows. Only take the trade when Graves's Quickdraw is down.
edits.after: Level-2 shotgun poke plus a Quickdraw reset out-trades you before Rupture's delay resolves.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Graves must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: His full poke kit zones you off the wave and Quickdraw resets every trade before Rupture is back — concede this window.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Quickdraw's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Vorpal Spikes clear and Carnivore sustain come online, so his poke stops compounding and the lane genuinely levels out here.

edits.before: Feast stacks turn you into terrain — every R is permanent HP plus a true-damage execute. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Graves's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Feast (80s) is true damage — the armour Quickdraw stacks does nothing about it. Bait the dash in, Rupture him mid-air, silence the Quickdraw exit, then execute.

edits.before: Heartsteel is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Quickdraw's cooldown.
edits.after: Heartsteel plus Vorpal Spikes breaks his freeze — force fights while Quickdraw is down.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Graves carry threat 8/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: A fed Graves bursts you with Collateral Damage (100s at rank 1) before Q-W lands — you peel, he executes. A coinflip.

edits.before: Track Graves's Quickdraw: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. When it is down — Q-knockup + Feast the kill.
edits.after: End of the Line detonates on terrain — it cuts your retreat and you have no dash. Silence locks Quickdraw for 16s.

edits.before: - Graves Quickdraw: matchup-defining — His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Graves Quickdraw: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1, but his attacks cut it, so count his ammo not the clock. Collateral Damage is 100s at rank 1. Feral Scream locks the dash out entirely. - Feast: kill windows only.

edits.before: Q under Graves's feet as he commits, W-silence the answer, and E-spike the trade — your sustain regens what his chip cost.
edits.after: Rupture under his feet as he dashes in, Feral Scream so Quickdraw and Smoke Screen are both locked, then E-spike the trade.

edits.before: Graves's window: Buckshot's three-pellet cone plus a Quickdraw dash lets him burst-poke and reset the trade before Rupture's delay lands or your autos answer.
edits.after: Graves's window: his New Destiny shotgun cone plus a Quickdraw dash lets him burst-poke and reset the trade before Rupture's delay lands or your autos answer.

edits.before: Graves's level 2 Buckshot poke plus the Quickdraw dash out-trades you hard while you have no waveclear and only a dodgeable, delayed Rupture.
edits.after: Graves's level 2 shotgun poke plus the Quickdraw dash (16s at rank 1) out-trades you hard while your only answer is a dodgeable, delayed Rupture.

edits.before: Vorpal Spikes cone clear and Carnivore sustain come online, so you farm through his Buckshot poke and the lane levels out.
edits.after: Vorpal Spikes cone clear and Carnivore sustain come online, so you farm through his shotgun poke and the lane levels out.

edits.before: Graves out-ranges you at levels 1-3 — Buckshot's burst cone and his auto poke chunk you while your only answer is a slow, telegraphed Rupture he can Quickdraw-dash out of. Don't throw a blind Q he'll just sidestep and punish; last-hit at max range and lean on Carnivore to heal the poke. Smoke Screen blinds your autos and cuts vision, so never commit Rupture-into-Feral Scream into the cloud — wait for it to drop before you walk up.
edits.after: Graves out-ranges you at levels 1-3 — his New Destiny shotgun cone and End of the Line chunk you while your only answer is a slow, telegraphed Rupture he can Quickdraw-dash out of. Don't throw a blind Q he'll just sidestep and punish; last-hit at max range and lean on Carnivore to heal the poke. Smoke Screen cuts your sight range and slows you, so never walk your Rupture-into-Feral Scream into the cloud — wait it out, then step up.

edits.before: Lean on Carnivore sustain and farm with Vorpal Spikes through his Buckshot poke until your stacks and tankiness take over
edits.after: Lean on Carnivore sustain and farm with Vorpal Spikes through his New Destiny shotgun poke until your stacks and tankiness take over

edits.before: Poke with Buckshot's burst cone from range, then Quickdraw out and reset the trade before your delayed Rupture can land
edits.after: Poke with his New Destiny shotgun cone from range, then Quickdraw out and reset the trade before your delayed Rupture can land

edits.before: Drop Smoke Screen to blind your autos and cut vision when you step up for the Rupture-Feral Scream combo
edits.after: Drop Smoke Screen to cut your sight and slow you when you step up for the Rupture-Feral Scream combo

notes: 'Buckshot' is not a Graves ability in the current kit and appeared six times in this entry — Q is End of the Line and the shotgun cone is the passive New Destiny (four bullets, not three). I replaced every instance. 'Smoke Screen blinds your autos' is also not in Riot's description, which gives only sight reduction, a slow and damage; I rewrote it to the described effect rather than assert a blind. Packet flagged wants.you[0] 'Feral Scream's' as a probable wrong name — false positive. Cho'Gath's kit flags Rupture as 'grounding'; Riot's text says it pops enemies into the air, so I wrote knockup.
